value_stream.name: B2B Bulk-Project Custom Import (Indent Sourcing & Brokerage Operations)

fields.Participants: Freight Coordinator, Drayage Carrier Dispatcher, Customer Site Engineer

workflows.name: Direct Port-to-Jobsite Transit Logistics Planning and Route Survey

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile logistics application displaying approved route restrictions and digital permits.
Controls: - CTL-25: In-transit cargo safety controls; Fleet Manager route sign-off.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Truck ban infraction risk**: Drayage trucks seized by municipal traffic authorities for violating local truck ban ordinances; mitigated by obtaining official LGU exemption permits (VS-76).
System Touchpoints: - Fleet Operations module (VS-06), LGU Permit Tracker (VS-76).

steps.activity: Conduct physical route survey to identify height clearances, bridge weight limits, and truck bans.
Secure local LGU special permits for oversized cargo or route exemptions.
Establish transit schedule avoiding municipal truck ban hours (typically peak commute windows).
Brief transport crew on route restrictions and emergency contact protocols.

fields.Participants: Logistics Fleet Supervisor, Heavy Equipment Operator, Safety Officer (VS-147)

workflows.name: Jobsite Unloading Site Readiness and Heavy Equipment Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - Site checklist submission portal with photo confirmation upload features.
Controls: - CTL-778 (ensure controlled execution — Direct Port-to-Jobsite Customs & Logistics (PA-182.3).)
- operational: Asset protection controls; Project Manager site clearance verification.
Cross-references: - links to VS-147 (premises safety), VS-12 (installation services)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Crane failure risk**: Inadequate crane capacity or rigging failure damages imported cargo during unloading; mitigated by requiring crane operators to submit valid safety certificates and load charts.
System Touchpoints: - B2B Customer Portal, Site Management module.

steps.activity: Verify unloading zone space availability and ground stability at jobsite.
Mobilize mobile cranes, forklift operators, and rigging crew matching cargo dimensions.
Establish safety perimeter and secure overhead power line clearances.
Transmit site readiness confirmation to drayage dispatcher.

fields.Participants: Customer Site Engineer, Drayage Driver, Quantity Surveyor

workflows.name: Direct Delivery Container Devanning and Joint Quantity Survey at Jobsite

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile tablet application with barcode scanning and instant photo upload to JQS database.
Controls: - CTL-21: Inventory accuracy controls; QA Director verification of JQS uploads.
Cross-references: - links to VS-31 (quality management), VS-171 (loading zone)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Receiving discrepancy dispute risk**: Customer claims shortages after container leaves site; mitigated by signing the joint (BuildRight–customer) JQS statement at the time of seal breaking.
System Touchpoints: - B2B Site Delivery module, Quality System (VS-31).
Time Estimate: - ~4.5–7.5 hours per container devanning (per the step durations)

steps.activity: Verify container seal number matches BOC documentation before breaking seal.
Unload materials and perform joint physical count (BuildRight inspector + customer surveyor).
Inspect materials for visual transit damage, warping, or water ingress.
Draft Joint Quantity Survey (JQS) statement; sign off by inspector and client.

fields.Participants: Import Coordinator, Transit Underwriter Agent, B2B Sourcing Manager
fields.Trigger: Signed JQS statement (W5243) showing damage or shortage

workflows.name: Materials Discrepancy Damage Claims and Transit Insurance Execution

Automation Opportunity: - Automated insurance form generator parsing data from JQS records.
Controls: - CTL-14: Transaction integrity match; CFO approval on claim write-offs.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Claim notification lapse risk**: Insurance claims declined due to late filing; mitigated by enforcing system alerts requiring document submissions within 48 hours of JQS signature.
System Touchpoints: - Insurance Claims Management module (VS-26), General Ledger (VS-17).

steps.activity: Compile damage files: photos, JQS statement, carrier logs, and commercial invoice.
Submit official claim request to transit insurance provider within required window.
Coordinate claims inspection with insurance adjuster.
Track settlement receipt and post recovery income in General Ledger.

fields.Participants: Key Account Manager, AR Analyst (VS-16.1), Client Finance Officer
fields.Trigger: Signed JQS statement (W5243) showing successful material delivery

workflows.name: Progressive Project Billing and Milestone Payment Collection

Automation Opportunity: - Automated AR milestone tracking dashboard with alert notifications.
Controls: - CTL-12: Separate credit approval from sales execution; Controller review of AR aging.
Cross-references: - links to VS-16 (O2C), VS-18 (treasury), VS-181 (escrow financing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Receivables collection delay risk**: Milestone payments delayed due to customer paperwork bottleneck; mitigated by weekly AR follow-up and automated payment reminders.
System Touchpoints: - Billing Module, AR Module (VS-16), Cash Book (VS-18).

steps.activity: Generate progressive milestone invoice in ERP matching contract terms (typically 60% on delivery).
Transmit invoice and JQS statement to client finance team for approval.
Track payment collection matching payment terms (typically Net 30).
Reconcile collected funds in bank statement and post AR settlement.

fields.Participants: Import Coordinator, Chief Accountant (VS-17.1), Logistics Finance Analyst
fields.Trigger: Final payment collection and project logistics closure

workflows.name: Landed Cost Reconciliation and Arm's-Length Transfer Price Accounting

Automation Opportunity: - Automated variance calculation and transfer pricing markup engine in cost module.
Controls: - CTL-15: landed cost validation controls; Chief Accountant sign-off required.
Cross-references: - links to VS-158 (product costing), VS-17 (finance), VS-79 (tax)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Transfer pricing tax audit risk**: BIR audit flags non-compliant intercompany pricing; mitigated by maintaining documentation demonstrating compliance with OECD transfer pricing guidelines.

steps.activity: Gather all actual landed cost components (freight, duties, VAT, insurance, brokerage, drayage).
Compare actual landed cost against original estimate; calculate cost variances.
Apply arm's-length transfer pricing rules between import entity and retail entity.
Post landed cost adjustments and transfer pricing entries in General Ledger.

fields.Participants: B2B Sourcing Manager, Quality Assurance Manager, Client Project Engineer

workflows.name: Project Sourcing Closeout Warranty Activation and Customer Handover

Automation Opportunity: - Portal-driven warranty registration with automatic expiry alerts.
Controls: - CTL-37: warranty validation controls; B2B Head of Trade / Account Management approval on project closeouts.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Warranty documentation loss risk**: Manufacturer warranty certificates lost during transit; mitigated by digitizing and hosting certificates on the customer portal.
System Touchpoints: - Customer Experience Portal, Warranty Tracking Module (VS-53).

steps.activity: Issue project completion certificate and transfer warranty documents to client.
Register materials serial numbers and batches in warranty tracking module.
Obtain client signature on project handover form.
Close B2B project contract folder in ERP.

fields.Participants: B2B Sourcing Manager, Category Manager, Import Buyer

workflows.name: Post-Project Margin Variance Analysis and Supplier Scorecard Review

Automation Opportunity: - Supplier performance analysis engine with automated scorecard updates.
Controls: - CTL-35: budget variance audit controls; VP Merchandising sign-off on scorecards.
Cross-references: - links to VS-03 (vendor mgmt), VS-127 (S&OP), VS-67 (vendor scorecard)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unaddressed supplier quality decay risk**: Underperforming suppliers continue to receive contracts due to stale data; mitigated by using real-time scorecard updates to block low-scoring vendors.
System Touchpoints: - Vendor Management module (VS-03), S&OP Performance Dashboard (VS-127).

steps.activity: Extract project gross margin metrics (original estimate vs. actual recovery).
Review supplier delivery performance, defect rate, and lead time compliance.
Update supplier scorecard ratings in vendor portal.
Present margin variance findings to VP Merchandising.
